The report reads 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS TX Coleman County 260526 Primary Runoff Election ... Election Day Precincts Reporting 4 of 4 ... Precincts Complete 0 of 4 ... Precincts Partially Reported 4 of 4', footer 'Election Summary - 05/26/2026 8:02 PM', county totals only; PDF CreationDate 2026-05-27 01:03:50 UTC (8:03 PM CDT); Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 00:39:30 GMT (7:39 PM CDT, earlier than the printed time, so the server or report clock is off; both fall on election night). Precinct reports for the runoff are under 'Official Election Results and Reports', e.g. 'OFFICIAL PRECINCT RESULTS - REPUBLICAN PARTY' ('OFFICIAL RESULTS ... PRECINCT RESULTS - REPUBLICAN PARTY'), CreationDate 2026-06-10, Last-Modified Wed, 10 Jun 2026 20:40:23 GMT. No precinct numbers on election night.
